name: writing

interface.longDescription: Two explicit-trigger skills for improving prose quality: agent-style applies 21 literature-backed rules for formal technical prose (papers, design docs, READMEs), and remove-ai-patterns removes AI-writing patterns at any register using the avoid-ai-writing catalog, voice profiles, and a deterministic Node.js detector.
capabilities: Apply agent-style rules to formal technical prose
Remove AI-writing patterns with voice profiles
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $writing to de-AI this text with remove-ai-patterns, or apply agent-style rules to formal prose.
